Retired year.note: The EIA-860M table for August 2026 lists Quindaro generator ST1 as retired in December 2024. GEM says 2019. A February 2019 KSHB news story says the Board of Public Utilities planned to shut both units by the end of 2019, but that is a plan, not proof of the closing date. The 2024 Board resource plan no longer lists the steam units. So 2024 is the only dated retirement found, and the 2019 plan may have slipped.

Conversion/replacement?.note: An EPA table of citizen settlements says the Board of Public Utilities agreed to stop burning coal at Quindaro units 1 and 2 by April 2015 and to convert them to natural gas. This matches GEM's value of conversion.
